Title: Predators in the Adirondacks
Content: To help keep the number of deer in check, an environmental group proposes the reintroduction of large predators, such as mountain lions, into the Adirondacks. Coyotes are a main predator of deer, especially the sick and young `text(ones)`. Opponents of the proposal believe that the Adirondack deer population has been regulated by coyotes, hunting, bad `text(winters)`, and land development projects. They also question the ability of the mountain lions to survive in the current Adirondack environment.
